row.team_price_text: Usage Based: $13.75/mo billed yearly ($15 monthly) + per-user charge
row.evidence: Travis CI users sign in through their GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab or Assembla account and accept Travis CI's authorization request; the pricing page, docs and API reference describe no SCIM or SAML for travis-ci.com.
row.notes: No SCIM and no SAML/OIDC SSO with a customer IdP on travis-ci.com: identity and repo permissions come from the connected VCS account via OAuth. The self-hosted Travis CI Enterprise/Server ($34/mo, Contact Sales) authenticates via GitHub Enterprise OAuth, so LDAP or SAML lives in GitHub Enterprise, not Travis. Plans are flat monthly prices (Usage Based $15/mo or $13.75/mo yearly, Unlimited $78+/mo or $72+/mo yearly); Usage Based also charges per user, so per-user fields stay null. The API v3 exposes read-only user lookups, a VCS sync trigger and undocumented /users/suspend and /users/unsuspend actions.
